svg.title: Earlier compositions rhyme beside the defensive circuit
svg.desc: Place the three earlier distributed-work compositions beside the defensive circuit at matching scale. Let structural resemblance remain visible without adding an accusatory connector or verdict.

**Frame:** No new speaker. The forum's four columns from [page 099](099.md) remain at the edge of frame. Against them, three of the book's own earlier images are set beside the closed defensive circuit at matching scale: the agent lanes of [page 007](007.md), the delegated workstreams of [page 011](011.md), the distributed route of [page 049](049.md). The compositions rhyme. Nothing is captioned as an accusation.

**Action:** The proposed remedy and the documented incident are shown to have the same shape.

**Caption:**
> THE ANSWER TO AGENTS MOVING FASTER THAN PEOPLE COULD FOLLOW IS AGENTS MOVING FASTER THAN PEOPLE CAN FOLLOW.
>
> IT IS OFFERED NOT AS A PREFERENCE BUT AS A NECESSITY.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — the project's structural observation. `OAI-BH` presents full automation as a requirement rather than a choice; the resemblance to the incident's own architecture is this book's reading and is not a claim of institutional bad faith.

", "title": "Earlier compositions rhyme beside the defensive circuit" } }
